basics.name: Paulo Antunes
basics.label: Senior Front-End Developer · Web Accessibility
basics.summary: 20 years building and shipping web products for organizations around the world — most recently as a Senior Front-End Developer on enterprise platforms across government, nonprofit, and membership sectors. What I bring to a team isn't just code: it's years of translating what stakeholders actually need into something a team can build and ship. Hands-on specialty: web accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA, ADA, Section 508).

work.name: Freelance
work.summary: Web development and digital strategy for my own clients, alongside agency and in-house roles. Contracts and invoices go through my Brazilian company.
highlights: End-to-end projects for direct clients in Brazil and abroad: UX/UI design, front-end and CMS builds, from concept to deploy.
Logo design for small businesses, carried into their websites and newsletters.

work.name: Taoti Creative
work.summary: While at Taoti, worked on enterprise Drupal and WordPress sites for Taoti's clients, including The German Marshall Fund of the United States, International Women's Forum, APTA, and IAAPA. Led web accessibility auditing and remediation (WCAG 2.2 AA, ADA, Section 508). Integrated AI tools into daily front-end workflows via Figma MCP integration.
highlights: Front-end developer on multiple enterprise Drupal and WordPress builds for high-profile clients, including The German Marshall Fund of the United States, International Women's Forum, APTA and IAAPA.
Specialized in web accessibility auditing and remediation, helping clients meet WCAG 2.2 AA, ADA and Section 508 so their sites work for everyone, including people who rely on assistive technologies.

Built responsive, component-based interfaces with HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript, Twig templates, Tailwind CSS, Lando environments and Git — maintaining long-term client sites through modular, maintainable code.

Integrated AI tools into daily front-end work: migrated legacy ACF field groups to native Gutenberg blocks, turned Figma specs into code through Figma's MCP integration, reused existing component patterns, debugged complex issues and extended search filtering.
Authored build specifications that scoped the technical approach for new projects and guided estimation.
Performed QA across the team's work: verified completed tasks, validated client sites after security updates and checked builds against requirements before release.

highlights: Contributed to a client project for Acquia, the company behind Drupal, as part of Crossover's global talent network.
Owned the SCSS / styling architecture for the Kitewheel MVP, taking it through to launch.

Contributed during a period of rapid growth in which Printi was named Best B2B Company by Brazil Founders (2014 and 2015).
